permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: OpenTypeless needs two macOS permissions to record and paste. Granting them now means dictation works on first try.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.afterClickHint: Toggle OpenTypeless on in System Settings → Accessibility, then come back.

settings.title: Settings
settings.clickToConfirm: Click again to confirm, or press another combination
settings.apiKeyUnreadable: Couldn’t read your keychain — your saved key may still be there
settings.apiKeyUnreadableHint: Unlock your login keychain and reopen Settings. Entering a key here replaces whatever is stored.
settings.apiKeyUnencrypted: Stored unencrypted — no system credential store is available on this machine
settings.storedLocally: Stored locally in your account, never in a settings file.
settings.sttLanguagesAutoHint: Auto Detect — speak any supported language.
settings.sttLanguagesSingleHint: Optimized for the selected language; others may transcribe less reliably.
settings.sttLanguagesMultiHint: Auto-detect among your selections; polish will favor these.
settings.selectedTextEditingDesc: Select text, hold the hotkey and speak an instruction — "fix the grammar", "make this shorter" — and the selection is replaced with the result. The capsule shows an amber ring while recording whenever a selection was found; no ring means the dictation will be inserted as usual. Browsers and Electron apps (Cursor, VS Code, Slack) do not expose their selection to macOS, so editing does not reach them.
settings.selectedTextEditingRequiresPolish: Requires AI Polish — the instruction is applied by the LLM.
settings.selectedTextEditingMacOnly: macOS only — reading the selection needs Accessibility, which has no equivalent on this platform.
settings.aboutDescription: Open-source AI voice input tool. Speak to write — turn your voice into polished text in real time.
settings.retentionHintForever: Entries are kept until you delete them.
settings.retentionHintDays: Entries older than {{days}} days are deleted automatically, including ones already saved and even while saving is off.
settings.retentionConfirm:
Keep history for {{days}} days?

Entries older than that will be deleted when you save. This cannot be undone.

dictionary.noEntries: No entries yet. Add proper nouns to improve recognition accuracy.

learnFromCorrections.label: Learn from corrections (experimental)
learnFromCorrections.description: After dictation, OpenTypeless watches your edits for ~15 s and offers to add fixed names and terms here. Reads the focused text field via macOS Accessibility — you'll be prompted to grant the permission on first use.

history.title: History
history.noHistoryHint: Press your hotkey to start recording and your transcriptions will appear here.
history.clearConfirm: Are you sure you want to clear all history? This cannot be undone.
history.savingDisabled: Saving is off — new dictations won't be recorded here. Entries below stay, but your retention setting still applies to them.
